name: gacp-lite
description: GACP Lite — ระบบยื่นขอและออกใบรับรอง GACP (standalone)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "pnpm --filter gacp-lite-backend dev" "pnpm --filter gacp-lite-web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter gacp-lite-backend prisma:generate && pnpm --filter gacp-lite-web build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "pnpm --filter gacp-lite-backend start" "pnpm --filter gacp-lite-web start"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter gacp-lite-backend exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema
scripts.db:migrate:dev: pnpm --filter gacp-lite-backend exec prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema
